extra.final_summary: Data problems found and fixed: (1) Removed 2 exact duplicate rows to ensure unique penguin records; (2) Normalized misspelled island names ("Dram" → "Dream", "Torgerson" → "Torgersen"); (3) Normalized case variant "FEMALE" → "female" for sex; (4) Converted body_mass_g from text (e.g., "3,600") to numeric. All data now complies with rules (valid species, island, sex labels; flipper_length_mm within [170, 235]). Average flipper length by species: Adelie = 190.375 mm, Chinstrap = 196.0 mm, Gentoo = 215.3913 mm.
